breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the exact integration method throughout, specifying P(x) = ρgA(L-x) as the continuously varying axial force and computing elongation via δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(AE) dx. There is no mention of replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load. This matches the ground truth prompt, which omits the incorrect instruction about collapsing the distributed load into a single end load.
